## Summary

Briefly explain the problem and the change.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests pass locally.
- [ ] Ruff lint and format checks pass.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where needed.
- [ ] Scientific claims are unchanged, or their evidence and claims-register entry are updated.
- [ ] Methodology changes were discussed and scoped before implementation.
- [ ] No coordinates, location clues, credentials, private/generated data, or large spatial files are exposed.
- [ ] Test fixtures use synthetic or clearly fictional data.

## Research and privacy impact

Describe any effect on methodology, reproducibility, public claims, or sensitive-data handling. Write
`None` when the change has no such effect.
